verdict.rationale: mParticle documents its own audience feature. Audiences are created in the platform and connected to outputs for activation, and an AI assistant can suggest audience logic from a plain-language description, which hints at a no-SQL workflow. Nothing in the pack shows a visual trait/behavior builder or an audience-size estimate before activation. missing for 10: evidence of a visual drag-and-drop builder combining traits and behavioral criteria, explicit no-SQL confirmation, estimated audience size before activation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can build audiences from traits and behavior in a visual builder — no SQL required — and see estimated size before activating

citations.quote: Once you have created an audience, you must connect it to an audience output where you can activate it.
Describe the audience, journey, or growth goal. mParticle understands the customer data behind it, suggests the logic to use, and helps turn intent into revenue-driving activation.
